title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for allegedly taking photos of a college acquaintance from her private social media account and using artificial intelligence to create obscene images and videos. Bansal, a BTech graduate in electronics and communication engineering from East Punjabi Bagh, reportedly ran multiple fake Instagram, Discord, and Facebook accounts along with several Gmail IDs to hide his identity while sharing the content.

The 22-year-old woman reported the matter to the North Delhi Cyber Police Station after anonymous Instagram accounts told her that morphed material was being circulated on Discord servers and she received threatening messages. Police traced the digital trail to Bansal, who said he knew the complainant from college and acted out of resentment after repeated insults. Officers recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence. Further investigation is ongoing.
